pr_body:
Motivation:

Http encoders/decoders and websocket handlers perform slow type checks
i.e. O(N) search among all implemented interfaces for non-implemented interfaces.

Modifications:

Perform instance exact matches and/or class type check vs common used types, while exposing
unstable APIs to allow users to do the same, if necessary.

Result:

Better performance of Http pipeline with/without websocket handler.
Fixes https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/13261

issue_context.title: HTTP/2 ALPN not working with BC FIPS TLS provider
issue_context.body:
### Expected behavior
Netty http/2 client includes the ALPN extension at the beginning of the TLS handshake to send a list of supported application protocols to the server as part of the ClientHello

### Actual behavior
Netty http/2 client does not include the ALPN extension at the beginning of the TLS handshake to send a list of supported application protocols to the server as part of the ClientHello when used with BC FIPS TLS provider (bctls-fips-1.0.13,jar)

### Steps to reproduce
Run a Netty based http/2 server  with multiple application protocols configured (http/1.1 , http/2)
Run a Netty based http/2 client  with multiple application protocols configured (http/1.1 , http/2)
The server and client is configured for TLS ,
Set crypto provider to bc-fips (bc-fips-1.0.2.3.jar)  , Set jsse provider BC FIPS TLS (bctls-fips-1.0.13)
The connection fails as the ALPN extension is not included in the client hello

### Minimal yet complete reproducer code (or URL to code)
https://github.com/rajeshpnair/nettyfipsissue/tree/main/HTTP2NettyTest

### Netty version
4.1.89

### JVM version (e.g. `java -version`)
11.0.16

### OS version (e.g. `uname -a`)
Windows_NT ICGLEBM432 10 00 x64
